title: A gate on a rule-guarding item names the exact marker text before the start
goal: Plan step 6 of /kb-sprint and kb/_self/backlog.md say that a blocking gate on an item whose touches are rule-guarding, when its answer introduces a marker other items or tools will match (a link text, a notes prefix, a name), names that exact text in the chosen option, so no worker meets the choice mid-work; a tested question of kb/_self's lookup_eval.csv answers it from backlog.md. It answers SP-4rq725fe, where ST-uifoyk4w's gate g1 chose a parked link but not its text, the worker's provisional gate became blocking on a rule-guarding item and was dropped from the commit, and the orchestrator recorded and answered g2 after the work.
